blocks.html: Ducts shall be supported in accordance with SMACNA/ANSI HVAC Duct Construction Standards – Metal and Flexible. Flexible and other factory-made ducts shall be supported in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Ducts shall not be hung from or supported by suspended ceilings.

Flexible and other factory-made ducts shall be supported in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions. Ducts shall not be hung from or supported by suspended ceilings.
